_comment: Rules for deterministic construction of OUT_PRODUCT_NAME and OUT_PRODUCT_GROUP. Format: [COMPANY] [CATEGORY] [PACK_SIZE] [CONTAINER] [VARIANT?]. Showcase edition: the production file mapped a partner's full manufacturer and retailer-category lists; this one keeps the same structure with a few fictional drinks companies.

company_codes._comment: Map IN_MANUFACTURER substrings to a company code. Checked case-insensitively, longest match wins.

independent_brand_prefixes._comment: The prefix used in PRODUCT_NAME/GROUP for each brand.

category_raw_to_code._comment: Category code from the retailer's category text. Checked case-insensitively, first match wins, so order matters.

container_keywords._comment: Scan merged input text for these keywords to determine the container. First match wins; order matters.

brand_container_overrides._comment: Force a container for these brands regardless of the keyword scan.

container_size_inference._comment: When no keyword is found, infer from size and count. Tall cans are listed separately so 500/591 ml correctly map to BTTL.

size_format._comment: Rules for formatting the size component of PRODUCT_NAME/GROUP.
size_format.l_format_note: Use Python f'{ml/1000:g} L' to trim trailing zeros: 2000 -> 2 L, 1750 -> 1.75 L

variant_suffix._comment: PRODUCT_NAME only, not GROUP. Added after the container for CSD multipacks up to 12 and large-format bottles of 2 L and up. 24-pack cubes and larger use no suffix.
